title: Netgear PCI Ethernet Card FA311 REV-C1 10/100Mbps, FA37C32136712, 00095B1E6686
categoryName: Computers/Tablets & Networking:Computer Components & Parts:Interface/Add-On Cards:Network Cards
descriptionText: The Netgear PCI Ethernet Card FA311 REV-C1 is a 10/100 Mbps network card designed for computers with a PCI port. It offers a maximum downstream data rate of 100 Mbps, making it suitable for high-speed internet connections. This card is compatible with Windows operating systems and is a reliable choice for expanding a computer's networking capabilities.
